title: Grants.
bodyText: The county system may seek and accept any funds or property and other desirable support and assistance from any source whatsoever, whether gift, grant, services, or any combination thereof, subject to applicable laws.
bodyHtml: [§46-197]  Grants.  The county system may seek and accept any funds or property and other desirable support and assistance from any source whatsoever, whether gift, grant, services, or any combination thereof, subject to applicable laws. [L 2021, c 208, pt of §1]
